task.description:
Validate that EE-12 (Concurrent instance safety) is ready for release.

Steps:
1. Read tests/reports/EE-12-run-01.md and verify overall result is PASS.
2. Run zig build and zig build test and confirm both exit 0.
3. Verify all EE-12 acceptance criteria from docs/requirements/EE-12.md are satisfied by the implementation:
   - Row-level locking used (FOR UPDATE NOWAIT in src/engine/instance.zig)
   - Two concurrent task completions on same instance: one HTTP 200, one HTTP 409
   - 100 concurrent completions across 100 distinct instances all succeed
   - Cross-instance contention is zero (no global lock)
4. Write a release decision to docs/status/release-EE-12-20260522.json with fields:
   - run_id, requirement_ids, decision (RELEASED or BLOCKED), rationale, tested_at, released_at
5. Set result.status to PASS if all checks pass, FAIL otherwise.
6. Include docs/status/release-EE-12-20260522.json in result.artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: test report shows PASS for all EE-12 test cases
All EE-12 acceptance criteria verified against implementation

result.summary: Release APPROVED for EE-12 (Concurrent instance safety). All acceptance criteria verified: FOR UPDATE NOWAIT row-level locking confirmed in src/engine/instance.zig; TC-EE-12-01/03 (100 concurrent distinct instances) PASS; TC-EE-12-02/04 (same-instance contention → HTTP 409) PASS; zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER to set EE-12 status RELEASED
